scope: Theorem 7.1 (Local energy descent) of the manuscript “Uniform Stability of the Spherical Laughlin Gap” (preprints/Uniform-Stability-of-the-Spherical-Laughlin-Gap-October-5-2026/uniform-stability-spherical-laughlin-gap.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 269 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b1bb20744f2bfa51), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 46. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are constants c > 0, L < ∞, and q0 such that, for every q ≥ q0, there is a measurable family of rapidly local physical operators Jy on Fq satisfying Z J∗ y Jy dνq(y) = Hq, Z J∗ y HqJy dνq(y) ≤ H2 q − cHq. (7.2) Every Jy has a definite particle loss ry ∈ {2, . . . , L}, so that [N, Jy] = −ryJy. The center measure has bounded mass per unit ball, and all rapid-locality bounds are independent of q and of the particle sector.
